reviews.text: Professional and gentle with animals.

Hello dear Luso,
We sincerely appreciate your feedback. We are sorry to hear that your experience was not positive - at Queridos Patudos we strive every day to offer a welcoming service to both animals and their owners. Your comment is very important to us and helps us to improve. If you wish, we are fully available to discuss the situation and ensure you have a more positive experience next time. Best regards, The Queridos Patudos Team. 🐾
